# Grokipedia

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia covering extreme metal music (Lorna Shore, deathcore), firearms and ammunition (.224 Valkyrie, AR-15 platform, SAAMI standards), interactive media, and diverse cultural topics.

Grokipedia serves as a reference wiki documenting niche and specialized knowledge across music, ballistics, film, literature, and technology. The site features detailed entries on technical specifications, artist discographies, and cultural artifacts with an emphasis on precision and completeness.

## Key Topics

- AR-15 platform
- Rifle cartridges and ballistics
- 5.56×45mm NATO and .223 Remington
- SAAMI standards
- Lorna Shore and Will Ramos
- Deathcore and extreme metal
- Century Media Records
- Symphonic and technical metal
- Interactive and experimental media
- Time-loop narratives
- Science fiction thrillers
- Choose-your-own-adventure formats
- AI benchmarking (τ²-Bench)
- New Jersey music scene

## Extreme Metal & Deathcore

- [...And I Return to Nothingness](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_I_Return_to_Nothingness): Lorna Shore's 2021 deathcore EP featuring Will Ramos debut on vocals
- [...Of the Dark Light](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Of_the_Dark_Light): Suffocation's 2017 death metal album via Nuclear Blast Records
- [...Famous Last Words...](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Famous_Last_Words...): My Chemical Romance single from The Black Parade album (2007)

## Firearms & Ammunition

- [.224 Valkyrie](https://grokipedia.com/page/.224_Valkyrie): Federal Premium's 2017 long-range AR-15 cartridge based on 6.8 SPC
- [.277 Wolverine](https://grokipedia.com/page/.277_Wolverine): Wildcat rifle cartridge for AR-15 platform, necked-up 5.56x45mm NATO
- [.22 TCM](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_TCM): High-velocity .22 caliber cartridge by Armscor for 1911-style pistols
- [.276 Pedersen](https://grokipedia.com/page/.276_Pedersen): Experimental 7x51mm rifle cartridge by John D. Pedersen for U.S. Army trials

## Music & Albums

- [...And Then There Were Three...](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Then_There_Were_Three...): Genesis' 1978 album marking trio lineup with Collins, Banks, Rutherford
- [(Chet Baker Sings) It Could Happen to You](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Chet_Baker_Sings)_It_Could_Happen_to_You): Chet Baker's 1958 vocal jazz album on Riverside Records

## Film & Interactive Media

- [+1 (film)](https://grokipedia.com/page/+1_(film)): 2013 sci-fi thriller by Dennis Iliadis about time-loop duplicates at party
- [...Meanwhile](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Meanwhile): Jason Shiga's interactive choose-your-adventure graphic novel (2001/2010)

## Technology & AI

- [τ²-Bench Telecom](https://grokipedia.com/page/-Bench_Telecom): Sierra AI's 2025 benchmark for evaluating telecom troubleshooting AI agents
